## Overview

### Why

The domain-modeling skill reads and writes the glossary as `GLOSSARY.md`. Under the old name, it would start a second glossary beside `CONTEXT.md`.

### Behavior change

None for users of the library. Agents and contributors find the glossary at `GLOSSARY.md`.

### Checks

- No reference to `CONTEXT.md` remains in the repository.

### Not covered

The glossary's entries do not change.

## Rename the glossary

`CONTEXT.md` becomes `GLOSSARY.md`, and its content does not change.
